**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

A bad egg
solution:
The correct answer is "A bad person."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

 
• The expression** "a bad egg"** is an idiom used to describe a person who is dishonest, untrustworthy, or morally corrupt. (ऐसा व्यक्ति जो बेईमान, अविश्वसनीय या नैतिक रूप से भ्रष्ट हो)
 
• Calling someone** "a bad egg" s**uggests that the individual has negative qualities or engages in deceitful behavior.
 
• It's a figurative way of expressing disapproval or distrust toward someone's character.
 
• This idiom is often used informally and might be applied to someone who consistently engages in dishonest or harmful actions.
 
• The correct answer is option 4.
